summary.text: Harvey S. Peeler Jr. is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 14, serving since 1981.
He chairs the Senate Finance Committee and is a dairyman and businessman.

paragraphs.text: Peeler was born on September 8, 1948, in Gaffney, and his official page lists a B.S. from Clemson University in 1970.
He served as a lieutenant in the U.S. Army from 1970 to 1972.
He served on the Cherokee County Council from 1977 to 1980 and has been in the Senate since 1981.
The page lists him as Senate Majority Leader from 2005 to 2016 and as President of the Senate from January 8, 2019, to December 6, 2021.
His committee assignments are Education, Ethics, Finance (chairman), Interstate Cooperation, Legislative Oversight, Medical Affairs and Transportation.
He married Ila LaDonna Caudill in 1969, and they have three children.
